video_title: Dwight Howard Gets REAL With LaVar Ball About Today’s NBA, Melo & Raising NBA Sons

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on his desire to see LaVar Ball shoot long threes
quotes.excerpt: If he was playing in my era when I was in my prime, I would want him to be shooting long threes.
quotes.quote: If he was playing in my era when I was in my prime, I would want him to be shooting long threes.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on why he would bench a player
quotes.excerpt: I bench them for two reasons. One, your ass is tired. Two, you ain't doing the job.
quotes.quote: I bench them for two reasons. One, your ass is tired. Two, you ain't doing the job.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on his role in creating the Big Baller Brand
quotes.excerpt: Me and LaVar Ball, we actually came up with the Big Baller Brand.
quotes.quote: Me and LaVar Ball, we actually came up with the Big Baller Brand.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on his journey from high school to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I really made it from high school to the NBA, the first pick.
quotes.quote: I really made it from high school to the NBA, the first pick. That was a lot of hard work, a lot of discipline, a lot of dedication, and a lot of God, man. All God.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on how fame and money can destroy a family
quotes.excerpt: Once you actually experience that whole like how much money and fame can destroy a family.
quotes.quote: Once you actually experience that whole like how much money and fame can destroy a family, because it can bring out the good or the bad in you depending on who you are. It's a very fine line, being famous or a celebrity and having money and then also at the same time being respectful, humble, courteous.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the father's role when sons start making money
quotes.excerpt: When the sons start making all the money, he kind of got to become the homie.
quotes.quote: When the sons start making all the money, he kind of got to become the homie. Because if you paying all the money, you got to do exactly what he say. Now, did that happen to your dad? Because I'm not like this, and this is normal. And let's say you have Ben Simmons and Ja Morant or whatever, when you making all the money now, you make all the decisions.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on the challenges of parenting NBA-bound sons
quotes.excerpt: How do I get my son to listen when he in a whole different tax bracket than me?
quotes.quote: How do I get my son to listen when he in a whole different tax bracket than me? He got his own, how is he going to listen to me? I had to go through that phase where like, man, these are my parents. They might not have had this type of experience, but the things they've experienced, they're teaching me from that.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on LaVar Ball's support for his sons
quotes.excerpt: I really always applauded you because a lot of people were upset at what you were doing.
quotes.quote: I really always applauded you because a lot of people were upset at what you were doing for your boys. And I'm sitting there like, how could you be upset when this man is literally every day, my sons are going to make it to the NBA. I'm going to push my kids.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on the lack of veteran leadership in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It just seems like it lacks veteran leadership.
quotes.quote: It just seems like it lacks veteran leadership. I don't think you have no veteran leadership with all this money. How can you have no veteran leadership when you're making 30, 40 million? You could be like, what you going to tell me, man?

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on his strategy for developing his sons
quotes.excerpt: I want to make a superstar, one superstar in every city.
quotes.quote: I want to make a superstar, one superstar in every city. And people say, you know what, I go to Chicago, I'm going to see this person. I'm going to see this person. Ain't nobody like that. It's just a bunch of thieves, guys who make the most money, and it's like that. So I'm thinking everything that the other dude is doing, they trying to reverse it. They already reversed it. Whoever going to make the most money, that's what they going to do.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on LaMelo Ball's global reach
quotes.excerpt: Melo is the most notable player on the NBA.
quotes.quote: Melo is the most notable player on the NBA. And you know this is your son, you just talking. Well, I'm telling y'all, with this social media, how could he not be? He been in 18 different countries and you got to watch my son grow up on Facebook. So who don't know him?

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on his early impression of LaMelo Ball
quotes.excerpt: I vividly remember watching Chino Hills and I'm seeing young Melo pointing and shooting from half court.
quotes.quote: I vividly remember watching Chino Hills and I'm seeing young Melo pointing and shooting from half court. And I say, you know what, he going to be the one. Out of all three of the Balls, he going to be the one.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the synergy of his sons playing together
quotes.excerpt: You put my boys together, they are the only ones when they play together, it's going to fast break.
quotes.quote: You put my boys together, they are the only ones when they play together, it's going to fast break every play. So make or miss, we throwing that long pass. Every play. Every play.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on developing players overseas
quotes.excerpt: I had Melo in my JBA playing, had him overseas playing with grown men.
quotes.quote: I had Melo in my JBA playing, had him overseas playing with grown men. Even in Lithuania, I'm trying to explain to these folks, that's the best time. Why? Because he can develop whether he playing the game or not. You practicing against grown men every day.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the roles of his sons
quotes.excerpt: Melo is the best at entertaining for my boys. Lonzo is the best leader, Gelo is the best scorer.
quotes.quote: Melo is the best at entertaining for my boys. Lonzo is the best leader, Gelo is the best scorer. They always had me, who the best, who the best. I'm just telling y'all. Scorer wise, Gelo going to be the best. Leader wise, Lonzo going to be the best. But entertaining win or lose, you going to watch Melo.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on his coaching philosophy regarding substitutions
quotes.excerpt: I'm like, y'all on this minute restriction on when you going to sub. That's when I sub.
quotes.quote: I'm like, y'all on this minute restriction on when you going to sub. That's when I sub. I'm going to ask you, if you was a coach, when would you sub? It would depend on if the other team came out and made a run.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: I'm like, y'all on this minute restriction on when you going to sub. That's when I sub. I'm going to ask you, if you was a coach, when would you sub?

text_blocks.speaker: Dwight Howard
text_blocks.text: It would depend on if the other team came out and made a run and I see that my first five is not energetic, I might bring in one or two guys to change the energy.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on his two reasons for benching players
quotes.excerpt: I keep it very simple. I only sub for two reasons. One, your ass is tired. Two, you ain't doing the job.
quotes.quote: I keep it very simple. I only sub for two reasons. One, your ass is tired. Two, you ain't doing the job. You got to go.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on Nikola Jokic's ability to play
quotes.excerpt: You talking about Joker, that boy can play.
quotes.quote: You talking about Joker, that boy can play. In here, he can play, he can play. But in the system I have, if I have you, you'll never be seen.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the impact of weight gain on players
quotes.excerpt: I always thought about the size and the weight. It don't matter if he gained 30 pounds.
quotes.quote: I always thought about the size and the weight. It don't matter if he gained 30 pounds. If he can't run, it don't matter. If his game got to stay the same. So he can eat and gain the weight, but if he not, you see he don't get injured like that because he don't have a lot of weight.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the defensive challenges of playing against big players
quotes.excerpt: Guys like you, Shaq, Moses Malone, heavy duties will break him in half.
quotes.quote: Guys like you, Shaq, Moses Malone, heavy duties will break him in half in the paint. And it's going to keep throwing the ball to me, you got to find me every time. I would be looking for somebody that size, 200 pounds and 7 feet. I will murder them. I will murder some dude like that, man.
